name: com.opoi375.physics-simulation
description: A deterministic physics simulation toolkit for Unity: mass-spring systems solved with semi-implicit Euler and substepping, PBD cloth with wind and obstacles, soft bodies that turn any mesh into a volume-preserving jelly, and injectable collision proxies (sphere, oriented box, capsule, half-space) bridged from scene colliders. Gizmo visualization plus one-click editor demo scenes included.
